statements.status_notes: Same upstream Gemfile pin as CVE-2023-49090: GitLab restricts carrierwave to ~> 1.3 and the fix is only in 2.2.6+. Major-version bump must come from gitlab-org/gitlab.

Fix is only available in carrierwave 2.2.5+. GitLab pins 'gem carrierwave, ~> 1.3' in its Gemfile and only ships 1.3.x; bumping to the 2.x line is a major upstream API change and must come from gitlab-org/gitlab. Tracking with GitLab upstream rather than mutating their Gemfile here.
